messages:
sophie-sales: Acme POC - logs + traces not correlating and frequent 429s. Need swarming help and quick pricing note for 1.5TB/month POC.

ben-eng: Can you paste a sample event and any 429 headers? Also which shipper (Fluent Bit/Fluentd/OTLP)?

acme-poc: Using Fluent Bit, trace is in payload as `tid`. Sample event:
`{"ts":"2026-03-10T09:12:01Z","level":"info","msg":"ok","tid":"t-99","user":"u1"}`
Headers when 429:
`HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 45
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`

keiko-sre: That Retry-After shows ingestion qps hit. Short term: enable batching and map `tid` -> header. For Fluent Bit filter: `[FILTER]
    Name  modify
    Copy  tid X-Trace-Id`
And in output: `Header X-Trace-Id $X_TRACE_ID`.

ravi-se: Also advise exponential backoff + file buffer. We can temporarily raise their org burst to 1800 qps for 48h.

ingest-bot: rate alert org=acme-poc qps=1100 limit=1000 spike=100 ts=1780123300

mike-security: For enterprise: logs encrypted in transit, hosted KMS available for Dedicated. I'll share CIS/SOC docs.

sophie-sales: Pricing quick answer for POC (1.5TB): Tara will confirm formally, but approximate $0.09/GB ingest POC -> ~$138 *monthly* (1.5TB = 1536GB * 0.09). Will send official quote.

ben-eng: If they set header and batching and still miss traces, check ingestion parser mapping: we index `trace_id` field by default. We can add temporary ingestion rule mapping `tid` -> `trace_id`.

keiko-sre: I'll apply mapping now and enable 48h uplift on request. Confirmed mapping rule id=map-512.

ingest-bot: uplift applied org=acme-poc new_limit=1800 ttl=48h id=uplift-512

acme-poc: After mapping and tuning we see much fewer 429s and traces now show in Console. Thanks!

sophie-sales: Great. Actions: keiko to monitor, mike to send security docs, tara to send pricing. Closing once finance sends quote. :thumbsup:
